title: Sebi’s CAS guidelines likely within a week, says chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey
description: Sebi chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said the regulator expects to issue guidelines on the settlement-price mechanism for derivatives on expiry days within a week. The move follows a review of the Closing Auction Session. Sebi is also working on simpler regulations, easier market access, lower compliance costs and stronger technological resilience.

title: Industrial, warehousing space leasing hits record 59.1 mn sq ft in top 24 cities in Jan-Sep: Savills
description: From January to September, leasing of industrial and warehousing spaces surged across major cities in India, propelled by demand from sectors like light manufacturing, e-commerce, and third-party logistics. Tier-I cities alone accounted for 47.2 million sq ft of leasing. Additionally, fresh supply increased to 68.9 million sq ft, signaling promising market trends as consumption patterns shift and supply chains are being optimized.

title: BPTP sells 150 apartments in its new housing project at Faridabad
description: BPTP Ltd has achieved a remarkable feat by selling 150 luxury apartments in Faridabad, translating to a total revenue of Rs 150 crore. Their housing development, dubbed 'SkyNest', has accumulated around Rs 750 crore in sales thus far, with each flat averaging Rs 5 crore. As a prominent player in the real estate market, BPTP has developed over 25,000 residences over the past twenty years.

title: Adani Green Energy H1 Update: Operational capacity rises 24% YoY to 20,763 MW, energy sales jump 32%
description: Adani Green Energy reported a 24% year-on-year rise in operational capacity to 20,763 MW in H1FY27, while energy sales jumped 32% to 25,747 million units. The company added 4,083 MW of greenfield capacity and expanded its battery storage portfolio. Its board will consider Q2FY27 financial results on October 21.

title: DMart Q2 Results: Cons profit rises nearly 9% YoY to Rs 743 crore, revenue jumps 18%
description: DMart operator Avenue Supermarts reported an 8.5% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 743 crore in Q2FY27, while revenue grew 17.8% to Rs 19,644 crore. However, EBITDA and profit after tax margins declined amid entry-level wage inflation. The company opened 15 new stores during the quarter, taking its total to 518.

title: Bitcoin reclaims $82,500 as improved ETF flows lift market sentiment. Here is what experts say
description: Bitcoin reclaimed $82,500 on Saturday after hitting a nearly three-week low earlier in the week, as improved ETF flows supported sentiment. Experts flagged institutional outflows, US-Iran tensions and AI-related security concerns as risks. Bitcoin and Ethereum remained down over the week, while derivatives data showed substantial liquidations across crypto markets.

title: Peter Cundill’s investing lessons: Why patience, research and value matter in stock picking
description: Peter Cundill’s value-investing philosophy centred on buying undervalued stocks with a margin of safety, conducting thorough research and exercising patience. His approach stressed examining business fundamentals, setting clear investment criteria, maintaining an investment journal and reassessing decisions when facts changed, offering lessons for investors seeking long-term wealth creation.

title: FIIs dump Indian stocks for eight straight weeks: Is a reversal on the cards or more pain ahead?
description: FIIs sold Indian equities for an eighth consecutive week, offloading Rs 30,294 crore, while DIIs bought Rs 30,313 crore to cushion the outflows. The Nifty 50 ended marginally higher, snapping its losing streak. Elevated crude oil prices, rupee weakness and global bond yields remain key factors shaping the outlook for a sustained recovery.

title: Canara HSBC Life Q2 profit rises 5% YoY to Rs 43 crore
description: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company's September quarter has marked a significant growth, with a 5 percent rise in net profit, totaling Rs 43 crore from Rs 41 crore last year. This quarter also saw total income climb to Rs 2,511 crore, a rise in net premium collections reaching Rs 2,553 crore, and an increase in first-year premiums to Rs 642 crore, showcasing the company’s robust financial health.

title: RBI to conduct Rs 25,000 cr OMO sale auction of government securities on Oct 13
description: On October 13, the Reserve Bank of India plans to auction government securities valued at Rs 25,000 crore. This operation will present six distinct securities, each with maturities ranging between 2030 and 2034. The central bank will determine the accepted amounts and may opt for lower bids. At present, the banking sector holds a surplus liquidity estimated at approximately Rs 3.88 lakh crore.
